_comment: Rolled-up registry of every item — GENERATED by items/pipeline/sync.py from the per-item items/<id>/item.json manifests. Read this one file to load the whole catalog; paths are repo-relative. Do not hand-edit (edit config/roster.json).

MISC.label: Junk
MISC.summary: Loot dropped by monsters with no use but gold — body parts, hides, feathers, minerals, oddments. Sold at any shop.

SOUL.label: Soul Stone
SOUL.summary: A soul stone dropped by monsters — the card of one specific creature. Merged into a weapon or a piece of armor to grant it the stone's power; the stone is consumed by the merge. `one_per_monster` makes the binding STRICTLY 1-to-1: a stone is dropped by exactly one monster and a monster drops exactly one stone, so the wiki can show the creature on the stone and the stone on the creature. A stone with no monster yet is UNBOUND (it waits for one) — never a second stone on a monster that already has one.

CONSUMABLE.label: Consumable
CONSUMABLE.summary: Used from the bag for an immediate effect — potions, elixirs, food. Consumed on use.

SWORD.label: Sword
SWORD.summary: Melee weapon. Equipped in the weapon slot; can carry merged soul powers.

BOW.label: Bow
BOW.summary: Ranged weapon. Equipped in the weapon slot; can carry merged soul powers.

WAND.label: Wand
WAND.summary: Magic weapon. Equipped in the weapon slot; can carry merged soul powers.

ARMOR.label: Armor
ARMOR.summary: Worn protection. Equipped in the armor slot; can carry merged soul powers.

items.name: Amber Root
items.description: Hacked off a Stumpling's root-leg and glazed hard with amber sap. Warm to hold, and alchemists know it.

items.name: Hawk Feather
items.description: Barred brown, olive at the tip, shed by an Emberwing or fired from a Quillkin. Fletchers never ask which.

items.name: Obsidian
items.description: Fist-sized lump of glossy black glass, cooled out of some fire-thing's crust. Keen enough to shave with, so don't.

items.name: Black Glass
items.description: Slab of black volcanic glass, faceted and chipped. Rimeshard grows through it, and Slaglings just shed the stuff.

items.name: Onyx Shard
items.description: Wedge of near-black glass with a cold blue sheen, cracked from a Slagling's crust. The edge never dulls.

items.name: Rib Cage
items.description: Spine and curved ribs, bleached clean. A Palehusk wore it badly, and a Glowbone would have lit it up.

items.name: Sea Shells
items.description: Scallops and spirals, sun-faded to tan. The tide made them, and the swamp does nothing but carry them about.

items.name: Rift Geode
items.description: Split grey stone bleeding cold cyan light from every seam. Frostlings hoard them and Rimeshards grow around them.

items.name: Beast Tooth
items.description: Thumb-long ivory with a notched crown. A Palemaw bites once; a Diretusk never has to. Both leave these.

items.name: Grave Dirt
items.description: Crumbly dark earth studded with bone chips. Whatever the Palehusk climbed out of, it brought some along.

items.name: Root Bundle
items.description: Brown roots tied off with twine and dried brittle. Whatever woodland lump was hauling it does not want it back.

items.name: Plume Bundle
items.description: Green, teal, blue and red plumes on a pale cord. Emberwing-gaudy, and whatever wore them is no longer loud.

items.name: Boar Tusk
items.description: Snapped off at the root, cream shading to brown. The Diretusk it belonged to never broke stride.

items.name: Bronze Knife
items.description: Camp bronze on a ribbed wooden grip, made for rope and rations. The Nightmule that hauled it went feral first.

items.name: Quartz Shard
items.description: Prised out of Mosscairn rubble and Rimeshard ice alike: one six-sided white point ringed with chippings.

items.name: Stone Egg
items.description: Fitted stone plates packed into an oval, shaken loose from a Magmashell. Nothing has ever hatched out of one.

items.name: Coiled Rope
items.description: Braided tan hemp, chewed to a splay at one end by a Nightmule with opinions. Still holds a knot, mostly.

items.name: Magma Stone
items.description: Faceted like an egg, orange over deep red and split with glowing seams. Fire-things leak these when they crack.

items.name: Bone Talon
items.description: Hooked grey bone, thick and cracked at the base. Fiends and the glowing dead shed them, and the point stays keen.

items.name: Crab Pincer
items.description: Brown, jointed and hooked at the tip. Whatever the swamp blobs swallowed to get it went down sideways.

items.name: Curved Fang
items.description: White ivory going tan at the root, worn fine by use. Cave-jaws and dusk-hunters both leave these behind.

items.name: Bat Wing
items.description: Dark membrane on thin bone struts, folded shut. Torn off a Frostwraith, and it still turns rain nicely.

items.name: Oak Plank
items.description: Planed dark oak, the grain unmistakable, knocked out of a Stumpling. It walked once, and now it holds shelves.

items.name: Dry Grass
items.description: Olive stalks tied off with cord, hauled out of a meadow nest. Poor fodder, but it burns beautifully.

items.name: Rune Locket
items.description: Oval bronze, knotted with spirals nobody reads aloud twice. The Palehusk wore it under skin that was not its own.

items.name: Ember Shard
items.description: Leaf-shaped crystal veined orange and red. It stays warm in the pouch, like the shell it was prised from.

items.name: Gilded Fang
items.description: Someone gilded a hunter's tooth, hollow at the root and polished bright. Nobody asks whose mouth it left.

items.name: Husked Nuts
items.description: Hard glossy kernels streaked tan and brown, a good fistful. Small woodland things hoard them, and now so do you.

items.name: Mandrake
items.description: A knobbly root with legs of its own and a wilted crown. The Stumpling was carrying it, or it was family.

items.name: Gold Ore
items.description: Rubble-grade rock studded with raw gold. It was a Mosscairn's shoulder until you argued about ownership.

items.name: Amber Fang
items.description: Broad amber-yellow tooth, split from crown to root. Even a Palemaw loses one on the wrong kind of bone.

items.name: Jade Shard
items.description: Teal-green crystal with a wicked point, chipped off a Rimeshard mid-swing. Holds an edge and a grudge.

items.name: Herb Bundle
items.description: Long green stalks tied into a sheaf, damp from the ditch some blob had been squatting in.

items.name: Green Slime
items.description: Half a pond-dweller, domed and translucent, still faintly warm. Alchemists want it and will not say why.

items.name: Rock Pile
items.description: Rounded brown stones in a heap, which is all a Mosscairn amounts to once the magic stops holding it together.

items.name: Sage Leaves
items.description: Bitter grey-green leaves off the meadow scrub. Good in stew, better in poultices, fatal by the handful.

items.name: Iron Chain
items.description: Three pitted iron links, worn smooth where a harness rubbed. The Nightmule that wore it is still out there.

items.name: Hooked Wing
items.description: Leathery brown membrane on finger-bones, with a claw at the crown. Emberwings and Frostwraiths both fly on these.

items.name: Nacre Shard
items.description: Turn this flake of shell and it shifts green to violet. The Magmashell that grew it was not asked to hand it over.

items.name: Ivory Talon
items.description: Cream-white and curved to a needle point, the socket left ragged. Duskfangs and Glowbones grow them by the set.

items.name: Great Pearl
items.description: One flawless sphere, off-white with a lilac sheen. Magmashells grow them, and Frostlings swallow what they find.

items.name: Thread Spool
items.description: Half a spool of plain linen thread. Something stitched the Palehusk together, and it was not a tailor.

items.name: Loose Teeth
items.description: Molars, curved fangs and small incisors, no two from the same jaw. Palemaws and Emberjaws shed them constantly.

items.name: Matted Pelt
items.description: Coarse black fur clumped and matted, with stray quills caught in it. Something out there is patchy now.

items.name: Mint Slime
items.description: Mint-green, translucent, and lit by a pale core. Every pond blob in the valley leaves one behind, wobbling.

items.name: Driftwood
items.description: Grey, water-worn branches still furred with moss. Cut a Stumpling down and this is most of what is left.

items.name: Watcher Mask
items.description: Grim steel with cheek guards and a third eye graven above the slits. The fiends that wore it had spares.

items.name: Beast Molars
items.description: Two grinders with forked roots, one big enough for a Diretusk. Both chewed harder things than grass.

items.name: Shadow Claw
items.description: A matched pair of glossy black hooks, sharp as the day they grew. Duskfang and its cousins do not give them up.

items.name: Bone Beetle
items.description: Palm-sized and bone-pale, its plated back mottled tan, six legs tucked under. The valley's small fry all carry one.

items.name: Pale Wing
items.description: Tan membrane on pale finger bones, torn free mid-flight. The gaunt things that haunt the drifts fly on these.

items.name: Frost Quartz
items.description: Ice-blue spires on a common base, cold indoors and out. Rimeshard grows this in its rock and swings the rest.

items.name: Rime Stones
items.description: Blue-white pebbles, a good dozen, that will not melt in the palm. Whatever a Frostling is packed from, this is it.

items.name: Moth Wing
items.description: Pale tan and ribbed brown, with a blue sheen at the base. An Emberwing's gaudy wings, minus the fire.

items.name: Ivory Horns
items.description: Four ivory horns splayed from one base, ridged like bark. Fiends and wraiths grow them for arguments they win.

items.name: Silk Skein
items.description: Silvery cord wound tight and bound at the waist, cool to the touch. Emberwings and grinning shadows leave it.

items.name: Hornet Nest
items.description: Tan paper in banded layers, one dark doorway low on the side. Prised out of a Stumpling's moss, and empty. Mostly.

items.name: Pitted Ring
items.description: Thick hammered silver, tarnished and pitted all over, off a Palehusk's borrowed finger. It fits nobody at all.

items.name: Beast Eye
items.description: Whole and damp, a brown iris in a veined tan ball. The fiends that carry spares will not miss this one.

items.name: Iris Petals
items.description: Purple petals with pale wedged stems, gathered past bloom. Meadow blobs trail them wherever they bounce.

items.name: Venom Claw
items.description: Pulled from an Ashfiend before it crumbled. The purple hook is fine, but the green crust on the tip is not.

items.name: Prism Plume
items.description: Banded blue to red down a tan quill. An Emberwing sheds a tail of them and still outshines any real dragon.

items.name: Raw Meat
items.description: Thick, red, rimmed with brown fat. Which beast it came off is between you, the cook, and nobody else.

items.name: Cloth Roll
items.description: Coarse grey canvas off a Nightmule's pack, rolled tight and trailing a tail. Tents do not sew themselves.

items.name: Rough Stone
items.description: Cracked brown rock with flat faceted sides. Half the things that shed it were walking around a moment ago.

items.name: Clawed Foot
items.description: Three cream claws on a brown scaled foot, cut clean at the joint. An Emberjaw's still holds its heat.

items.name: Scaled Paw
items.description: Mottled grey-green hide and three pale curled claws. Emberjaw and Palemaw both leave them, never in pairs.

items.name: River Stone
items.description: Worn smooth, grey-blue and cold in the palm. Every pond blob keeps one, and none of them will say why.

items.name: Snow Tuft
items.description: A burr of white fur bristling every way, blue in its shadows. Warm to wear, and slow to finish thawing.

items.name: Gloom Cap
items.description: Fat violet cap, pale freckles, thick lavender stem. It grows on Stumplings, which should tell you plenty.

items.name: Marrow Bone
items.description: Knobbed at both ends and stained where beige should not be. A Palemaw was busy with it before you were.

items.name: Rough Hide
items.description: Pegged square with little wooden stakes, edges left ragged. Somebody began the tanning and gave up on it.

items.name: Teal Quill
items.description: Teal at the base, gold at the tip. Emberwing plumage, or a Quillkin needle that missed you narrowly.

items.name: Bone Bundle
items.description: Long pale bones from a Glowbone, bundled and gone dark. The shine leaves them within the hour.

items.name: Tooth Ridge
items.description: Ivory cones socketed in a slab of jawbone, unblunted. Whatever carried it never needed a second bite.

items.name: Twig Skimmer
items.description: Four glassy wings over a body like a snapped twig. Shaken loose from whatever swamp thing you flattened.

items.name: Yellow Molar
items.description: Thumb-sized, yellowed and worn flat. Grinding teeth like this come out of things that chew all day.

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Violet facets around a gold rune, cut from an Emberwing. Hits land arcane, and spells come back to hand faster.

soul.power: +20 arcane damage on hit and -10% spell cooldowns

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Dark banded stone lined with living gold, pulled from a Glowbone. Burns with light, and nearby undead go blind.

soul.power: +20 radiant damage on hit and blinds undead within three tiles

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Charred black, cracked open by molten veins. Magmashell's banked fire, and it leaves what you hit burning.

soul.power: +14 fire damage on hit and sets targets burning for 3s

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Blue slate cracked around a cold white star. Nobody has found what grows these, only that they frost a blade.

soul.power: +9 frost damage and slows struck targets by 25%

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Dull brown plates veined with copper, left by a Puddling. Thickens armor and roots you where you stand.

soul.power: +12 armor and 15% knockback resistance

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Packed grey-green cobbles with no light left in them. Its creature is still unmet, and blows slide past whoever holds it.

soul.power: +8% dodge chance and attackers miss more often in dim light

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Mossy green split by a red vein, cut from a Stumpling. It hits harder and feeds the wound back to you.

soul.power: +9 damage on hit and heals you for 8% of damage dealt

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Plated grey rock split by a bright cyan seam of Rimeshard ice. In a blade it bites deep frost and leaves the target wading.

soul.power: +16 frost damage on hit and slows the target by 30% for 3 seconds

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Pebbled black stone veined in cyan, the storm inside a Frostwraith. Its lightning strikes, then jumps to the next body.

soul.power: +15 lightning damage with a 20% chance to chain to a second target

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Woodgrain runs black through it, all a felled Sprigling leaves. It hardens armor and hands blows back to the giver.

soul.power: +8 armor and 5% of damage taken is reflected to the attacker

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Sea-green stone mended in gold, prised from a Palemaw's jaw. Armor holds better, and more coin turns up.

soul.power: +15% gold found and +6 armor

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Cobbled grey rock leaking the green that kept a Palehusk walking. In a weapon its poison layers wound on wound.

soul.power: +13 poison damage on hit stacking up to five times

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Grey plates shut around a clot of Duskfang red. It sharpens a weapon and feeds part of every wound back to you.

soul.power: +6 damage and heals for 15% of damage dealt

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Black and webbed with hollow cracks, the dark that wore Grinmask's smile. Its cuts carry shadow straight through armor.

soul.power: +14 shadow damage on hit and ignores 10% of enemy armor

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Mottled swamp-green, all a Mirewart leaves behind. Keep it near and small hurts seal themselves while you walk.

soul.power: +3 health regeneration per second

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Matte black and light-swallowing, an Ashfiend burnt down to this. It strikes with shadow and can hide you after a kill.

soul.power: +14 shadow damage and 15% chance to fade from sight after a kill

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Rough brown rock seamed with raw gold. No creature has yet been caught carrying one, which stops nobody looking.

soul.power: +18% gold found and each critical hit drops 5 gold

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Blackened shell webbed with live lava, still too hot to pocket. Nothing anyone has killed yet was carrying it.

soul.power: +22 fire damage on hit and burns the target for 4 per second

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Mossed plates around a yellow-green star, torn from a Mosscairn. It strikes with growth and knits you as you fight.

soul.power: +10 nature damage and +2 health regeneration per second

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Olive and root-threaded, taken from a Nightmule's stubborn heart. Your blows turn green and your wounds close over.

soul.power: +10 nature damage on hit and regenerates 3 health per second

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Chalk-cream and webbed with fissures, pulled from a Diretusk's ivory. It plates your armor against breaking.

soul.power: +12 armor and immunity to fracture effects

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Sun-bleached with a gold heart, wrung out of a Dewling. It makes blows land heavy and leaves them blinking.

soul.power: +8 blunt damage and attacks blind the target for 2 seconds

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Granite plates seamed in salmon pink, dropped by a fleeing Fluffang. Armor that shrugs off falls and crushing weight.

soul.power: +15 armor and 10% reduced damage from falling and crushing blows

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Cracked dark rock veined with live red, still warm from the Emberjaw. It sets whatever you strike alight.

soul.power: +12 fire damage on hit and burns the target for 4 per second

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Pale blue and rimed white, all that survives a Frostling's melt. Hits land cold and sometimes drag the target down.

soul.power: +10 frost damage on hit and 20% chance to slow the target

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Old iron gone sour, weeping copper from every slit. Quillkin leavings, and they rot armor right off a foe.

soul.power: +9 damage on hit and reduces the target's armor by 6 for 8 seconds

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Scorched dark red with embers sulking in the cracks, the last of a Slagling. It warms your blade and your hide.

soul.power: +4 fire damage on hit and 10% burn resistance

items.name: Soulstone
items.description: Night-black and star-flecked, prised out of a Balefiend. Void-heavy hits, and now and then you blink in behind.

soul.power: +22 void damage on hit and 10% chance to blink behind the target
